capabilities: create new notes from a chosen template via a base's New button
write base filter values and template properties into the new note
set a target folder and a file name pattern for new notes per base
add extra properties with date, time and title variables
duplicate the current note as a new note (Pro)
extras: Freemium: Pro features (multiple templates with a picker, per-view templates, Templater support, duplicate as new note) need a GitHub Sponsors payment of $5/month or $15 once, with device-flow sign-in that checks sponsorship via the GitHub API; core features work without an account and make no network requests. After updates it opens a What's new tab that suggests other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat.
intentEvidence: The plugin waits for the app to finish its own step, then rewrites the note in one edit
problem: Bases' New button only writes filter values into an empty note, so users still have to open the note, delete it and insert a template by hand.

relations.evidence: Bases Note Templates makes the New button of a base start new notes from a template.

summary: Bases extension that makes the New button of a base create notes from a chosen template, with filter values as properties, a target folder and a name pattern.
